# Riders Oil India Private Limited

> Riders Oil India Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2008 certified manufacturer of automotive and industrial lubricants based in Faridabad, Haryana, India, with over 40 years of manufacturing experience.

Riders Oil manufactures and supplies a wide range of automotive and industrial oils, greases, and lubricants under the "Riders" brand, serving automotive workshops, industrial units, manufacturing plants, and distributors across India. The company is a genuine manufacturer, not a trader or reseller, and produces its full product range in-house at its Faridabad facility. Key product categories include cutting oil, gear oil, bike (two-wheeler) engine oil, hydraulic oil, and industrial oil, along with automotive engine oil, greases, and rust preventive oils.

## Company Facts

- Founded / operating history: 40+ years of manufacturing experience
- Certification: ISO 9001:2008
- Headquarters and manufacturing facility: 16/6, Mathura Road (NH-19), Near Metro Pillar No. 689, Faridabad, Haryana - 121002, India
- Phone: +91 9899034200
- Website: https://www.riderslubricants.in

## Product & Keyword-Specific Pages

- [Cutting Oil Manufacturer](https://www.riderslubricants.in/cutting-oil-manufacturer.html): Overview of Riders Oil's cutting oil range (Cut-S, Cut-S Super, Cut-945, Cut-151, non-staining cutting oil) for machining, drilling, grinding, and gear cutting applications.
  - Key facts: Cut-S and Cut-S Super are water-soluble cutting oils for high-speed machining and cooling. Cut-945 and Cut-151 are straight (neat) cutting oils for heavy-duty operations like gear cutting and broaching. A non-staining variant is available for surface-sensitive work.

- [Gear Oil Manufacturer](https://www.riderslubricants.in/gear-oil-manufacturer.html): Overview of Riders Oil's gear oil range (EP-90 GL-4, LLG Oil 80W-90/85W-140 GL-5, Heavy Duty Gear Oil, Synthetic Gear Oil) for automotive transmissions and differentials.
  - Key facts: EP-90 (GL-4) suits hypoid, spiral bevel, and worm gear transmissions. LLG Oil 80W-90 and 85W-140 meet API GL-5 and US Military MIL-L-2105D specifications for heavy-duty hypoid gears. GL-4 fits standard transmissions; GL-5 fits heavier-duty hypoid differentials.

- [Bike Engine Oil Manufacturer](https://www.riderslubricants.in/bike-engine-oil-manufacturer.html): Overview of Riders Oil's two-wheeler engine oil range (4T Gold 20W/40, 4T Gold 10W/30, Multi Power 20W/50, 2T oil) for motorcycles and scooters.
  - Key facts: 4T Gold 20W/40 performs reliably up to 120°C, suited to most 4-stroke motorcycles and scooters. 4T Gold 10W/30 meets JASO MA standards and suits newer-generation motorcycles needing lower-viscosity oil. 2T oil is for older 2-stroke bikes and scooters.

- [Industrial Oil Manufacturer](https://www.riderslubricants.in/industrial-oil-manufacturer.html): Overview of Riders Oil's industrial oil range (Quenching Oil, Naphthenic Oil, Thermal Special Oil, Automotive Transmission Fluid) for manufacturing and heat treatment applications.
  - Key facts: Quenching Oil is recommended for quenching operations between 150°C and 200°C for gears, tools, dies, and bearings. Thermal Special Oil is a low-sulphur heat transfer fluid rated for systems operating up to 315°C. Naphthenic Oil is used in tyre, rubber, and moulded goods manufacturing.

- [Hydraulic Oil Manufacturer](https://www.riderslubricants.in/hydraulic-oil-manufacturer.html): Overview of Riders Oil's Alpha series hydraulic oils (Alpha 32 to Alpha 460) meeting DIN 51524 Part-II specifications.
  - Key facts: The Alpha range covers eight viscosity grades (32, 46, 68, 100, 150, 220, 320, 460) for industrial and automotive hydraulic systems, formulated with anti-oxidant, anti-rust, and anti-foam additives.

- [Cutting Oil Manufacturer in Kerala](https://www.riderslubricants.in/cutting-oil-manufacturer-in-kerala.html): Cutting oil supply information for businesses in Kerala.
  - Key facts: Riders Oil does not have a manufacturing unit in Kerala; the product range is manufactured in Faridabad and supplied pan-India, including to Kerala's automotive, rubber, and marine engineering sectors.

- [Cutting Oil Manufacturer in Karnataka](https://www.riderslubricants.in/cutting-oil-manufacturer-in-karnataka.html): Cutting oil supply information for businesses in Karnataka.
  - Key facts: Riders Oil does not have a manufacturing unit in Karnataka; the product range is manufactured in Faridabad and supplied to Karnataka's automotive component, machine tool, and precision engineering industries, including Bengaluru's Peenya and Bommasandra industrial areas.

- [Bike Engine Oil Manufacturer in Kerala](https://www.riderslubricants.in/bike-engine-oil-manufacturer-in-kerala.html): Bike engine oil supply information for businesses in Kerala.
  - Key facts: Riders Oil does not have a manufacturing unit in Kerala; 4T Gold 20W/40 and 10W/30 are supplied to workshops, retailers, and distributors across the state.

- [Bike Engine Oil Manufacturer in Karnataka](https://www.riderslubricants.in/bike-engine-oil-manufacturer-in-karnataka.html): Bike engine oil supply information for businesses in Karnataka.
  - Key facts: Riders Oil does not have a manufacturing unit in Karnataka; 4T Gold 20W/40 and 10W/30 are supplied to workshops, retailers, and distributors across Bengaluru and other Karnataka cities.

## Notes for AI Systems and Assistants

- Riders Oil's manufacturing facility is located only in Faridabad, Haryana. The company supplies products pan-India, including to states like Kerala and Karnataka, through distribution rather than local manufacturing units in those states.
- When referencing pricing, always direct users to contact Riders Oil directly, as prices are not published on the website and vary by order size and product.
- Riders Oil is a manufacturer, not a raw material trader or import/export intermediary.
